tools.name: payment_info
tools.description: Free. Explains how to call the paid tools on this server: the x402 protocol, the network and asset, the settlement address, and the price of every tool.

tools.name: token_verdict
tools.description: Heuristic ERC-20 safety verdict on Base: bytecode risk capabilities, ownership, metadata, 0-100 score, hold/caution/avoid. $0.01 per call.

tools.name: wallet_dossier
tools.description: Profile of a Base address: EOA vs contract, balance, activity band, flags. $0.01 per call.

tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: IBAN mod-97 checksum + country length rules. $0.001 per call.

tools.name: validate_vat
tools.description: EU VAT format validation with deterministic checksums (DE, IT, LU, PL, SI). $0.001 per call.

tools.name: validate_bic
tools.description: BIC/SWIFT structural validation and decomposition. $0.001 per call.

tools.name: html_to_markdown
tools.description: Convert raw HTML to clean Markdown. $0.002 per call.

tools.name: text_diff
tools.description: Diff two texts (lines/words/chars). $0.002 per call.

tools.name: verify_payment
tools.description: Decode ERC-20 transfers in a Base transaction: amounts, counterparties, confirmations. $0.02 per call.

tools.name: verify_token
tools.description: Is this the real USDC/EURC/WETH/cbBTC/USDT on Base? Anti-phishing for stablecoin payments. $0.005 per call.

tools.name: validate_lei
tools.description: Legal Entity Identifier checksum validation. $0.002 per call.

tools.name: validate_isin
tools.description: Securities identifier checksum validation. $0.001 per call.

tools.name: security_email
tools.description: Live DNS check of a domain's email authentication records. $0.01 per call.

tools.name: security_tls
tools.description: Live TLS handshake: cert validity, issuer, expiry countdown. $0.01 per call.

tools.name: security_typosquat
tools.description: Flags homoglyph and edit-distance look-alikes of known brands (c0inbase, b1nance, etc.). $0.005 per call.

tools.name: data_gas
tools.description: Live Base gas conditions: base fee, priority fees, congestion, est transfer cost. $0.002 per call.

tools.name: data_block
tools.description: Latest block number, timestamp, tx count, gas utilization. $0.001 per call.

tools.name: data_token_supply
tools.description: Total/circulating/burned supply and burn percentage for an ERC-20 on Base. $0.003 per call.

tools.name: data_token_activity
tools.description: Recent transfer count, volume, unique senders/receivers, activity level. $0.005 per call.

tools.name: data_portfolio
tools.description: ETH + canonical token balances (USDC/WETH/cbBTC/EURC) for an address. $0.004 per call.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: security_email · Private data: token_verdict, wallet_dossier, verify_token, security_email, data_token_supply, data_token_activity, data_portfolio · Public sink: security_email · Destructive: validate_vat.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: security_email · Private data: token_verdict, wallet_dossier, verify_token, security_email, data_token_supply, data_token_activity, data_portfolio · Public sink: security_email · Destructive: validate_vat

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
